name_en: Yakitsuke — mugwort mochi dough griddled and finished with miso
summary_ja: もち粉によもぎを練り込み、大きな鉄鍋で薄く広げて焼き味噌ダレを塗る。昭和初期の食糧難の頃、出荷できないくず米の粉を使ったとされる素朴な農村食で、腹持ちがよく野良仕事の合間に食べられた。
summary_en: Mochi flour kneaded with mugwort is spread thin on a large iron griddle and finished with a sweet miso glaze — said to have used unmarketable broken rice flour during the food shortages of the early Showa era, a filling snack eaten between stretches of farm work.
source_title: 焼き付け 富山県｜うちの郷土料理
